inputs.instruction: Broad follow-up audit of QuickJS parser, bytecode compiler/interpreter, and runtime crash surfaces reproducible with small standalone JavaScript files. Do not restrict the search to the previous await candidate; explore parser edge cases, bytecode emission, exception/control-flow cleanup, modules, typed arrays, async jobs, GC interactions, and runtime builtin misuse. Prioritize deterministic ASan crashes, aborts, assertion failures, and segfaults with a minimal single-file JavaScript PoC.
